findings.title: Regular paid-expense entry does not complete payment/accounting on save
findings.classification: Functional mismatch — newly clarified paid-entry requirement
findings.current_behavior: The normal expense editor selects a cash/bank account and server validation already requires one for non-reimbursement expenses. However, createExpenseForActor saves DRAFT; submit/approval/post actions are separate, so a successful initial save does not complete the paid-expense accounting flow. There is no claim that a required-account check is missing.
findings.expected_behavior: Regular expenses are recorded as already paid and capture the account paid from at entry. Regular expenses do not have Due/Paid workflow controls; those apply only to recurring bills. The paid entry must reconcile to the actual cash/bank payment and expense accounting exactly once, while preserving authoritative permissions and approval policy.
findings.root_cause: Regular entry currently implements draft creation with a separate posting workflow, whereas user now requires an already-paid entry flow. Payment-entry and approval/accounting lifecycle need a deliberate common design.
findings.module_impact: EXPENSES core; preserve PROJECTS restrictions for project-linked expense.
findings.permission_impact: Preserve creation/posting/approval role distinctions. This requirement does not authorize arbitrary users to bypass posting or approval permissions.
findings.branch_company_impact: Paid-from account must belong to actor company and applicable branch; preserve project/branch authorization.
findings.accounting_financial_impact: Required saved paid entry must match expense and cash/bank reporting once; avoid a second expense/payment journal when an already-paid record is later approved/posted.
findings.required_fix: After implementation approval, support the clarified paid-entry business flow atomically with validated paid-from account and payment date, idempotency and appropriate accounting/approval controls; present paid status separately from any internal approval state where necessary. Keep Due/Paid actions exclusive to recurring bills.
findings.required_tests: Regular paid expense entry with authorized cash/bank; missing/wrong-company/wrong-branch account denied; role and approval thresholds; exactly-once journal/payment under retry/concurrency; cash/bank/P&L reconciliation; period locks; native/web parity; no Due/Paid controls on regular expenses; recurring overdue-paid flow remains supported.

findings.current_behavior: unitConversions is written to settings and read for web explanatory labels/preservation only. Repository search found no conversion consumer in inventory or sales/purchase posting. Native does not load/display saved conversions.

findings.required_fix: Connect assignment/rule resolution to accepted transaction model; validate compatibility and preserve historical conversion snapshots.
findings.required_tests: Save/reload on web/native; one bundle=10 pieces; secondary-unit purchase/sale/return quantity and value; reverse conversion; no duplicate cost; unchanged historical documents.

Product/service masters persist an explicit secondary-unit snapshot: one primary unit equals N secondary units. Web/native unit selectors require a positive exact factor and different units. Web action and both native master save paths preserve these fields. Shared validation requires active company-owned references; DB composite foreign keys and paired positive-factor checks protect direct writes. New base-unit assignment clears stale secondary mappings and audits prior mapping/factor. Historical item unit changes remain prohibited after stock/document history. This arithmetic layer is not yet wired to document/posting paths; no live quantity or ledger behavior changed.

findings.current_behavior: Web offers name, bankName, accountNumberMasked and IFSC only; native creates name/type/branch and edits name only. Holder name, bank branch name, IFSC lookup, printing switches and optional UPI ID are missing. Model/schema cannot persist them. findings.expected_behavior: Match the supplied conditional form and information sheets; save account metadata and printing preferences and honor them on applicable invoices. Keep the alternate UPI/account-number requirement unresolved until its rule is established.
findings.root_cause: MoneyAccount identity model is disconnected from per-account invoice configuration; native metadata inputs are omitted.

findings.accounting_financial_impact: Invoice recipient payment instructions must correspond to the selected authorized bank; QR rendering exists globally and is not wholly absent.
findings.required_fix: Persist reference metadata/preferences, wire conditional web/native form validation and invoice account selection, and provide truthful IFSC lookup/help. Preserve existing global printing support.
findings.required_tests: Both switches OFF, bank ON, QR ON, both ON; save/reload/edit; conditional fields; valid/invalid IFSC/UPI; correct account output and switch-off behavior across invoice formats.

Current web route is a generic branch/source/destination/amount/date/reference form. It lacks the reference option sheet, distinct Deposit/Withdraw modes, fixed Cash fields and image attachment. Android uses its generic transfer editor. These gaps and shared posting/replay/branch-context risks are already recorded in A064-F05/F06/F09/F10/F11/F13. No duplicate finding IDs added.

The transfer service posts balanced paired ledger lines atomically with its record/audit, validates active compatible accounts, and rejects identical accounts/nonpositive amount. This does not satisfy the missing reference UI. Adjust Bank Balance is a distinct action, not an ordinary transfer.

## A064-F05 — Bank balance adjustment and Add/Reduce Cash workflows are absent (Medium)

**Page ID:** A064

**Recommended fix:** Reuse the balanced transfer service behind reference-specific screens and authorized attachment storage; preserve separate adjustment semantics from A064-F05.

**Required tests:** All four entry points; source/destination labels and fixed Cash side; bank-to-bank distinct accounts; attachments upload/view/denied access; date/description; web/native parity and Back.

findings.title: Android repeated transfer submissions can post duplicate journals
findings.current_behavior: MoneyEditor generates UUID.randomUUID() for each confirmation. AccountMoneyViewModel.save launches a coroutine for each call without a saving guard; saving is never set true and the editor has no pending-state input. Two taps/retries therefore use distinct server idempotency keys; the service treats them as separate transfers.
findings.expected_behavior: One intended transfer posts once across double taps, slow responses and uncertain-network retries, with persistent pending state and the same request key until outcome is resolved.
findings.root_cause: Idempotency key belongs to each click instead of the intended operation; client submissions are not serialized.

findings.required_fix: Create/store one key per operation, guard and disable pending submissions, retain key/payload across retry and expose outcome recovery. Apply equivalent stable request handling to non-idempotent account creation.

**Expected/reference behavior:** One intended capital addition or drawing posts once across double taps and uncertain-network retries.

findings.title: Profit drawings do not enforce available funds in the selected money account
findings.current_behavior: postOwnerTransactionForActor validates an active compatible money account and posts WITHDRAWAL without querying its posted available balance. The isolated probe reaches journal posting for 5000 against a mocked zero-balance account. Shared postJournalInTx validates balanced entries/year/period and locks the company but contains no funds check.
findings.expected_behavior: Block drawings above the selected bank/cash account balance; no profit limit and no capital deduction. Recheck during atomic save so concurrent outflows cannot overspend.
findings.root_cause: Positive balanced journal construction is treated as sufficient, without available-funds validation.
affected_services_apis_actions: Owner capital report and Assets summary dependency

findings.accounting_financial_impact: An overdraw can be posted under the present code; no live overdraw was executed. Preserve contributed capital and do not introduce a profit threshold.
findings.required_fix: Calculate authoritative available account funds including effective reversals under the appropriate transaction lock; check after lock and coordinate with other outflow writers. Reject insufficient funds before journal/owner row/audit creation.
findings.required_tests: Zero, exact balance, one paisa excess; 5000/3000 owners; cash/bank/branch compatibility; simultaneous drawings and transfers; reversals; rollback and retry.

findings.title: Cheque records have no amount or normalized source-payment linkage
findings.current_behavior: Cheque stores partyName, number/date, account, status, optional reference and journalEntryId, but no amount, party ID, source sale/payment/document ID or source type. Input strips supplied amount; ordinary settlement PaymentMode is CASH/BANK only and no cheque creation/linkage call exists in its service. Manual creation is separate from the reference payment-generated list.
findings.expected_behavior: Preserve cheque amount, actual source/payment identity and authorized View Txn linkage; cheque payments appear once in the list with correct reference data.
findings.root_cause: Cheque model is a detached status register instead of a payment-linked instrument.
affected_services_apis_actions: Mobile money context / missing cheque lifecycle actions
findings.module_impact: Core cheque/cash/bank accounting; no optional module bypass established. Preserve other money navigation.
findings.permission_impact: Reads MONEY_VIEW, mutations MONEY_ENTRY; linked bounce also invokes JOURNAL_REVERSE. Explicit lifecycle policy needs coherent UI/API enforcement; company/assigned-branch predicates exist.
findings.branch_company_impact: Company and assigned-branch guards exist for reads/new writes. Selected branch context omitted by loader; use scoped actual source/destination and transactional lifecycle checks. No cross-company leak reproduced.
findings.accounting_financial_impact: Manual closure must atomically post the actual receipt into selected bank/cash once, reconcile source cheque/payment and audit without duplicate income. Open recording alone must not increase bank/cash. Re-Open undo policy remains to be explicitly confirmed before implementation.
findings.required_fix: Add validated amount and normalized scoped source/payment relation; integrate explicit cheque receipt/issue lifecycle without duplicating sales/settlements. Link actual source journals rather than an arbitrary same-branch posted journal.
findings.required_tests: Cheque sales/receipts and issues; amount precision; source linkage/foreign-source denial; View Txn; existing manual data migration; no duplicate income/receivable settlement.

findings.title: Concurrent cheque transitions use stale state and unconditional writes
findings.current_behavior: Transition reads outside a transaction, validates in-memory status and updates by id only. Parallel mock DEPOSITED and CANCELLED from RECEIVED both pass validation and update, with no expected-status predicate; stale transitions may overwrite valid lifecycle state or diverge from financial effects.
findings.expected_behavior: Only one valid transition commits against the current state; repeated identical intent is safely acknowledged and incompatible concurrent intent is rejected.
findings.root_cause: Read/validate/write lifecycle has no lock, compare-and-swap or stable operation identity.
affected_services_apis_actions: Mobile money context / missing cheque lifecycle actions
findings.module_impact: Core cheque/cash/bank accounting; no optional module bypass established. Preserve other money navigation.
findings.permission_impact: Reads MONEY_VIEW, mutations MONEY_ENTRY; linked bounce also invokes JOURNAL_REVERSE. Explicit lifecycle policy needs coherent UI/API enforcement; company/assigned-branch predicates exist.
findings.branch_company_impact: Company and assigned-branch guards exist for reads/new writes. Selected branch context omitted by loader; use scoped actual source/destination and transactional lifecycle checks. No cross-company leak reproduced.
findings.accounting_financial_impact: Manual closure must atomically post the actual receipt into selected bank/cash once, reconcile source cheque/payment and audit without duplicate income. Open recording alone must not increase bank/cash. Re-Open undo policy remains to be explicitly confirmed before implementation.
findings.required_fix: Lock/re-read source in the atomic transaction or use expected-state compare-and-swap; coordinate with journal effects and replay payload equivalence.
findings.required_tests: Deposit/cancel, clear/bounce, reopen/clear races; duplicate click/retry; state/journal/audit agreement; no double reversal or stale overwrite.

findings.title: Journal reversal leaves loan principal and paid-off lifecycle stale
findings.current_behavior: Generic reversal permits posted loan journals and reverses JournalEntry only. Repayment aggregate includes every LoanPayment, including rows whose journal was reversed; PAID_OFF is not restored. Receipt reversal likewise does not reconcile Loan status.
findings.expected_behavior: Effective loan principal, status, history and liability journal must agree after any supported reversal.
findings.root_cause: Loan lifecycle is detached from generic journal reversal and aggregate ignores effective journal status.
findings.module_impact: Core money/loan accounting; preserve existing navigation and optional module rules. No project-module dependency inferred from loan name Project.
findings.permission_impact: Reads ACCOUNT_MONEY_VIEW; mutations ACCOUNT_LOAN_ADMIN; generic reversal ACCOUNT_JOURNAL_REVERSE. Maintain server permissions and reflect them in UI.
findings.branch_company_impact: New loan/payment operations validate company, accessible branch and active compatible money account. Replay exception described in F07. List uses assigned branch scope but not selected branch context; scope new detail/statement explicitly. No cross-company disclosure reproduced.
findings.accounting_financial_impact: Existing receipt credits liability and debits cash/bank; EMI principal debits liability, interest/charges expense, total credits cash/bank. Principal overpayment guard and row lock exist. Reference example requires 100000 - 2000 = 98000 principal and 2550 payment total; fees separate. Reversal/duplicate risks recorded separately.
findings.required_fix: Either block generic reversal of managed loan journals or route through atomic loan-aware reversal, including status/outstanding reconciliation and immutable history/audit.
findings.required_tests: Reverse partial/full EMI; restore outstanding and ACTIVE after full EMI reversal; reversal retry; receipt with subsequent payments; journal/liability versus statement reconciliation.

checkpoint_work.work: Added typed, whitelisted non-commercial Home source adapters for receipts/advances, vendor payments, expenses/income and current estimates/quotations. Canonical role permission intersection, module gates, company/assigned-branch intersection, managed-project expense/payment scope and parameterized SQL are enforced. Distinct source/destination/print metadata prevents treating estimates as debt or paid expenses as unpaid. This adapter stage is not yet connected to the Home consumer; source-aware read destinations and native consumers must be completed before enabling it. Party-to-party semantics clarification is pending; unsupported source types are not invented.
checkpoint_work.tests: 12/12 grouped tests passed: 9 unit and 3 isolated PostgreSQL tests with two companies, real posted advances, current estimates and draft expenses. Verified actual joins/filters, company and assigned-branch isolation, role/module denial, safe search parameters, no private-field serialization and no journal writes during reads. TypeScript and targeted lint passed. Consumer/browser/native/final-head verification pending; status remains PARTIAL.

checkpoint_work.work: Added a scoped read-only payment/advance destination for Home, showing cash amount, discounts, applications and unallocated amount without posting or allocation. Receipt/advance module gates are independent and exact. Shared normalization preserves whitelisted metadata. PostgreSQL uncovered that settlements have scalar projectId without a Prisma relation; replaced the invalid spread query with authorized managed-project IDs in both adapters and reader. No new migration or financial writes. Home consumer integration is still pending, so adapters remain disabled there.
checkpoint_work.tests: 14/14 grouped tests passed (10 unit, 4 actual PostgreSQL): source filters, independent module and role gates, company/assigned-branch isolation, forbidden manager/unassigned receipts, invalid UUID, safe metadata and no journal writes while opening payment details. Earlier runtime project-relation failure corrected and rerun successfully. TypeScript and targeted lint passed. Payment-page browser/native consumer and final-head checks pending; status PARTIAL.

checkpoint_work.work: Added opt-in mixed Home controller and web source-aware row bindings. Routes use receipt/advance read view, expense details and quotation details; estimates/drafts hide debt and expense rows expose no unsupported print/share. Controller retains legacy mobile callers until native integration is completed; web consumer is enabled. Print reads restrict Project Managers to owned projects and omit consolidated party balances. No new migration or financial writes.
checkpoint_work.tests: 79/79 focused tests passed, including six isolated PostgreSQL cases, source controller merge/order/filter, positive and negative project print access, no read-side journal writes, and rendered source-specific link/no unsupported print assertions. TypeScript and focused lint passed before added tests; final-head/browser/native verification pending. Status remains PARTIAL. Subsequent desktop/mobile Chromium payment navigation passed 2/2 (27.4s), with scoped Axe AA, viewport overflow and read-only journal-count assertions. Initial browser fixture lacked a financial year; corrected fixture and reran. Web mixed-source consumer enabled; legacy mobile API remains commercial-only until native update.

checkpoint_work.work: Connected Android Home source metadata, distinct row keys, source-specific expense/quotation detail opening and authorized payment PDF preview. Native hides unsupported print/share and non-debt balances. Updated client opts into homeVersion=2; absent version preserves commercial-only mobile responses. Web mixed-source Home is enabled. No migration or accounting writes.

findings.title: Android edit/revision maps line fields into wrong constructor positions
findings.current_behavior: revise() constructs SalesLineDraft positionally. Its fifth/sixth arguments quantity/rate enter unitName/unitSymbol; discountType enters quantity, discountValue enters rate and taxRate enters discountType. This can produce invalid or altered save payloads.
findings.expected_behavior: Existing lines must preload exact quantity, rate, discount and tax in edit/revision.
findings.root_cause: SalesLineDraft added unit fields but this positional caller was not updated.
affected_services_apis_actions: Quotation web pages/actions and corresponding native/API paths, as identified in affected files
findings.module_impact: QUOTATIONS_BOQ must remain authoritative. Conversion must also enforce target Sales/Sales Order modules.
findings.permission_impact: Preserve VIEW/EDIT/APPROVE/SHARE and cost-visibility server boundaries; exposing a control does not prove authorization.
findings.branch_company_impact: Existing document queries scope company and assigned Branches; customer writes require matching Branch. No cross-company access demonstrated.
findings.accounting_financial_impact: Blocks or corrupts non-posting quote pricing/terms; downstream project/sale valuation can depend on quotation totals. No actual financial corruption demonstrated.
findings.required_fix: Use named constructor arguments and a dedicated quotation-line DTO/mapper; retain every existing field.
findings.required_tests: Native create→open→edit and new revision with tax/discount/custom units; payload identity assertions against original values.

findings.title: Android save cannot preserve existing adjustments, schedules and line metadata
findings.current_behavior: payload() always sends empty adjustments and paymentSchedule. QuotationDraft/preload omit existingLineId, specification, custom unit metadata and internalUnitCost. Backend draft update deletes/recreates rows; hidden custom cost is preserved only when existingLineId is provided. Revising similarly creates a reduced new version.
findings.expected_behavior: Untouched data must survive native edit/new revision, including hidden cost that user cannot view.
findings.root_cause: Native DTO/preload/payload are lossy compared with shared domain.
affected_services_apis_actions: Quotation web pages/actions and corresponding native/API paths, as identified in affected files
findings.module_impact: QUOTATIONS_BOQ must remain authoritative. Conversion must also enforce target Sales/Sales Order modules.
findings.permission_impact: Preserve VIEW/EDIT/APPROVE/SHARE and cost-visibility server boundaries; exposing a control does not prove authorization.
findings.branch_company_impact: Existing document queries scope company and assigned Branches; customer writes require matching Branch. No cross-company access demonstrated.
findings.accounting_financial_impact: Existing current draft terms/pricing can be lost on successful native overwrite; old issued revisions remain retained. Preserve non-posting boundary.
findings.required_fix: Preserve adjustment/schedule/line identity and all editable metadata; let server retain hidden values by authorized identity without sending private costs to Data Entry.
findings.required_tests: Web-created quote with fixed/taxable charges, schedule, specification, custom unit/cost→native no-op edit and revision; totals and hidden costs unchanged.

findings.title: Historical aging subtracts payments and credits after cutoff
findings.classification: Report source/reference function and UI audit
findings.current_behavior: Aging selects invoices dated through c.to, then calls documentOutstandingsBatch without cutoff. Helper subtracts every settlement allocation, advance application and posted source adjustment regardless of date. listOpeningOutstandings filters effectiveDate but likewise aggregates all opening allocations. Actual helper fixture invoice 100 before cutoff/payment 100 after cutoff returns outstanding 0; correct cutoff amount 100.
findings.expected_behavior: Historical receivable/payable aging reflects only transactions effective by cutoff, including opening amounts, refunds, credits and advances.
findings.root_cause: Current-outstanding helpers reused for historical reports with no allocation/adjustment date limit.
findings.module_impact: Each catalogue destination must retain its report-specific module/service gates; a visible label is not proof of implementation.
findings.permission_impact: Retain ACCOUNT_REPORTS and role/cost restrictions; Project Manager financial reports remain denied by shared context.
findings.branch_company_impact: Company and authorized Branches must remain scoped. Normalize selection and use one authorized effective filter for UI and all exports.
findings.accounting_financial_impact: Read/export only, no posting or double counting. Sale/credit note profit uses tax-exclusive revenue and linked inventory cost; estimates and loan receipts must not count as profit.
findings.required_fix: Introduce explicit as-of outstanding computation using authoritative effective transaction dates; retain current outstanding behaviour for current balances. Apply cutoff consistently to document and opening allocations, adjustments and advance applications.
findings.required_tests: Payment after cutoff; credit/debit note after cutoff; advance after cutoff; opening allocation after cutoff; reversal policy; future invoices excluded; same historical balance in export.

findings.title: Native exports can use edited filters while showing previous results
findings.classification: Report source/reference function and UI audit
findings.current_behavior: AccountReportViewModel dates/filter setters change state without clearing data or marking results stale. export builds filters from current editable state, while displayed data remains from previous run. Export buttons stay enabled during loading. Example: run October, edit November without Run, export November while October table stays visible.
findings.expected_behavior: Export matches displayed results and their applied filters, or clearly requires a successful rerun before exporting edited selections.
findings.root_cause: No saved applied-filter snapshot; export reads draft state rather than last successful report request.
findings.module_impact: Each catalogue destination must retain its report-specific module/service gates; a visible label is not proof of implementation.

findings.accounting_financial_impact: Read/export only, no posting or double counting. Sale/credit note profit uses tax-exclusive revenue and linked inventory cost; estimates and loan receipts must not count as profit.
findings.required_fix: Store applied report filters with successful results; export that snapshot or block export until draft filters are applied. Clear stale exports on edits and enforce request-generation correctness.
findings.required_tests: Run A/edit B/export; edits during pending run/export; failed rerun; report switch; unchanged filters; exported values agree with displayed applied period.

findings.title: Cancelled-sale reports retain reversal while excluding original invoice
findings.platform: Desktop Web + Mobile Web; shared report services where applicable
findings.current_behavior: reverseSale marks original invoice CANCELLED but retains POSTED credit. Profitability and party/GST document queries select only POSTED documents. Actual profitability fixture retains credit revenue -50/cost -20/profit -30 while omitting the fully reversed original; correct same-period pair nets zero. Historical periods can also lose the original after later cancellation.
findings.expected_behavior: Document-based reports agree with effective journals and preserve dated invoice/reversal history; fully reversed same-period sale nets zero.
findings.root_cause: Lifecycle cancellation is used as an economic exclusion although the original journal is not itself removed and is offset by a dated credit note.
findings.affected_services_apis_actions: See affected files and evidence; shared service/action consumers.
findings.affected_models: CommercialDocument/CommercialDocumentLine and associated journals
findings.module_impact: Sales amendment/report consistency
findings.permission_impact: No authorization bypass demonstrated by these checks.
findings.branch_company_impact: Fixtures scoped to one company; no live cross-company operation performed.
findings.accounting_financial_impact: Incorrect revenue/profit/party/tax reports despite an offsetting journal pair.
findings.required_fix: Define one authoritative effective-document/reversal policy shared by reports; include original and dated offsets consistently or exclude matched pairs only when appropriate to the requested period. Do not omit posted historical economic effects merely from current status.

findings.title: Failed sale replacement can leave two posted invoices
findings.platform: Desktop Web + Mobile Web; shared server action
findings.current_behavior: Actual replacePostedSaleAction first posts replacement, then reverses original. If original reversal and compensation reversal both fail, compensation error is swallowed and action throws while original and replacement remain posted. Isolated injected-failure probe records replacement posted and both credit-note post attempts failed, with no original cancellation.
findings.expected_behavior: An unsuccessful edit leaves one authoritative sale, or exposes and reliably resolves an explicitly tracked recovery state; retry cannot duplicate posting.
findings.root_cause: Multi-transaction replacement workflow relies on best-effort reversal with swallowed compensation failure and no durable recovery/idempotency state.
findings.affected_services_apis_actions: replacePostedSaleAction and sale-edit form
findings.affected_models: CommercialDocument, CommercialDocumentLine, JournalEntry and StockMovement
findings.module_impact: Sales edit/amendment workflow.
findings.permission_impact: No authorization bypass demonstrated by these probes; separate authorization review remains.
findings.branch_company_impact: Fixture uses one company/branch; no cross-company production access tested.
findings.accounting_financial_impact: Failure can leave duplicate posted revenue/receivable and stock effects until recovery; no live posting performed.
findings.required_fix: Implement an atomic authorized amendment where feasible, or durable idempotent workflow with locked source, recovery state, reconciliation and surfaced compensation failures. Prevalidate both sides before posting and bind replacement to original.
findings.required_tests: Original reversal failure; compensation failure; retry; concurrent payment/edit; financial-year lock; stock/batch/serial constraints; one live economic sale and balanced journals after recovery.
